decision: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
fact: The setup of the suspension has been changed while under Parc Ferme.
offence: Breach of Article 40.9 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
reason: MoneyGram Haas F1 Team changed the setup of the suspension of Car 87 under Parc Ferme, this not being in accordance with Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. Car 87 is therefore required to start the Race from pit lane.
rules_referenced: Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 87 Changes Made During Parc Ferme
to: The Team Manager, MoneyGram Haas F1 Team
